firstPlayerRule: Miss Scarlet always goes first. Play then proceeds, in turn, to the first player's left.
clarifications: Unused suspect pawns still go on their Start spaces, because they remain suspects.

sources.title: Clue — Classic Detective Game English/French instructions

internalEvidence: Downloaded the Hasbro US instructions for the classic Clue game (3–6 players; Miss Scarlet, Colonel Mustard, Mrs. White, Mr. Green, Mrs. Peacock, Professor Plum; Case File envelope) from the Hasbro instructions site page clue-game and extracted the text with pdftotext. PDF page 2 is a bilingual spread; the English Setup step 7 in the right-hand column (printed page 3) reads that Miss Scarlet always goes first and play proceeds to the first player's left. Cover copyright © 1986, 1998, 2002 Hasbro. SHA-256: 509db5d047e69536ba1b3ba29fcb2683a049005434075871d40cb0b67105789d. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25.
uncertainty: The rule sheet does not say who starts if no one is playing Miss Scarlet.
The newer 2023 Clue edition uses a die roll instead; check which edition you own.
